wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.emptyWishHint: Add pieces you dream of. They stay separate from your wardrobe until you buy them.
wardrobe.emptyHint: Add your first piece: a photo of the item, ideally cut out from the background.

item.styleIt: Style it: looks with this piece

form.badImage: Could not read this image. Try another one.
form.noClipboard: No image in the clipboard. Copy a cut-out in Photos first.
form.pasteDenied: Paste was not allowed. Try again and tap “Paste”.
form.creating: Creating the image, this can take a minute or two…
form.setTouching: The pieces touch each other in this image, so they could not be separated. Tap Regenerate.
form.setRegenerate: Regenerate first: the pieces could not be separated.
form.setCategory: Choose a category for each piece
form.fixPlaceholder: e.g. make it red, remove the belt, no cut-out on the back
form.background: The background is still there. That's fine, but a cut-out looks neater in outfits.
form.tip: Tip: in the Photos app, touch and hold the item until it lifts, tap Copy, then tap Paste here. iPhone removes the background for you.
form.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. make it red, only the skirt, without the belt
form.setHint: (suit, co-ord): AI draws all pieces in one image so the colour matches, then each piece is saved as its own item
form.setShared: These details apply to every piece of the set. Leave a field empty and AI fills it for each piece.
form.notesPlaceholder: Fit, fabric, what it goes with…
form.extraHint: Extra photos of the same piece help: the back, a close-up, the true colour. About +1¢ each.

outfits.title: Outfits
outfits.askStylistHint: Describe what you need: looks from your own clothes, with a photo on you
outfits.emptyHint: Put together a look from your wardrobe, or ask the stylist for ideas.
outfits.boardHint: Drag pieces to arrange them. Tap one, then pull a corner to resize it.
outfits.saveHint: “Save outfit” keeps this collage. “Generate with AI” saves it and draws you wearing it, in the look format.

looks.dressing: Dressing you up, about a minute…
looks.drawError: Could not draw it. Try again
looks.drawingCollage: Drawing all looks on you in one picture, about a minute…
looks.collageError: Could not draw the collage. Try again
looks.drawCollage: Draw all looks in one picture
looks.missing: Would make these looks even better: {{list}}
looks.wishPlaceholder: Wish (optional): e.g. for autumn, more relaxed
looks.weatherError: Could not get the weather. Allow location access or type it in.
looks.needItems: Add at least a few items to your wardrobe first.
looks.requestPlaceholder: What do you need? e.g. soft looks for autumn, +15, in pastel shades

inspo.title: Inspiration
inspo.formulasHint: Save looks you love and analyze them. When you have a few, find the patterns behind your taste.
inspo.needTwo: Analyze at least 2 looks first ({{count}} so far).
inspo.emptyHint: Add screenshots of outfits you love from Instagram or Pinterest. You can pick several at once.
inspo.notePlaceholder: What do you like about it? (optional)

shop.title: Shopping
shop.beforeBuyHint: Snap the item in the shop: does it really fit your wardrobe?
shop.checkHint: The stylist looks at your whole wardrobe and tells you what's missing, what you have too much of, and what to buy first.
shop.empty: Nothing yet. Add things from the wardrobe check or saved looks.
shop.notePlaceholder: e.g. wool, oversized, for the office

profile.title: My profile
profile.untaggedHint: Tags help the stylist. Open an item, tap Edit and then “Fill in with AI”.

account.languageHint: The app and the stylist’s answers use this language.

prefs.appearanceHint: The AI draws a woman who looks like this when it shows outfits on you. Write in English.

settings.hint: Platform settings. Only admins see this tab.

dict.deleteGlobal: Delete “{{name}}” from the defaults for everyone? Users whose items use it keep it in their own list.
dict.deleteUsed_one: “{{name}}” is used by {{count}} of your items. Remove it from your list and from it?
dict.deleteUsed_other: “{{name}}” is used by {{count}} of your items. Remove it from your list and from them?
dict.deleteKept_one: Remove “{{name}}” from your list? Your {{count}} item keeps it, it just stops being suggested.
dict.deleteKept_other: Remove “{{name}}” from your list? Your {{count}} items keep it, it just stops being suggested.
dict.globalHint: Defaults for every user. Users can change, add or hide entries for themselves; that never changes these.
dict.userHint: Your own lists: the defaults plus your changes. Removing a default hides it only for you.
dict.globalRename: Renaming a brand, material or type also renames it on every user’s items.
dict.userRename: Renaming updates your items that use it. Changes reach the AI right away.

look.label: One outfit on me
look.hint: Saved outfits and the stylist’s looks: you wearing one outfit, with the pieces and a palette.

many.label: One piece, many looks
many.hint: “Style it” on an item: one collage with the piece in the middle and several looks around it.

garment.label: Item photos
garment.hint: Enhance with AI: a clean product photo of a piece from a photo of you wearing it.

placeholder.scene: where she is and what she does
placeholder.title: the headline, e.g. ONE SWEATER

templates.needStyleIt: Try “Style it” on a piece once, then the example uses it.
templates.needOutfit: Save an outfit first, then the example uses it.
templates.newPicture: New picture: the instructions still describe the old one. Let the AI rewrite them for this picture, then check and save.
templates.fillsAlso: It also adds which attached photo is which.

users.hint: Admins manage the defaults on this Settings tab. Users only change their own lists.
